## Summary

Pardeep Kaushik is a Full Stack Developer in India with 5+ years of experience building business websites, ecommerce stores and custom web applications. Work includes WordPress, Elementor, WooCommerce, Shopify Liquid, React, Next.js, Node.js, API integrations, migrations, website speed optimization and VPS deployment.
